timing_scope: Nanoseconds per face, warmed native scalar C loop on distinct faces. Includes routing, analytic shortcut, inference for neural routes, certification, all corrections and writing results/counters, plus one ctypes call per batch. Excludes file reads, compilation, training, data generation and reference audits. Intra-round method order is randomized. Aggregation is median per batch divided by case count.

repeat_timing.description: Independent repeat with fresh process/compiler invocation and reversed split/tolerance order.
